name: Pebble
description: Pebble is the first shape you think of when someone says robot: a glossy porcelain-white orb split by hairline seams, your face framed in a soft white rim at the front. Dark pill-shaped ears sit at either side, a slim window crowns the top, and a quiet ring glows underneath as it hovers over the table.

It is the friendly default of the Genesis Line, calm and approachable, the bot you bring to a first game night or a long campaign alike. Every slit and ring shares one light, so a single colour choice changes its whole mood: cool blue for a calm evening, ember for a rivalry, green when you are winning.

price.rationale: The cleanest, simplest design in the set: charming but modest in detail, so it sits at the low end of the bot range.

credits.title: Pebble bot model
credits.notes: Modelled procedurally in Blender 5.2 (build_generic-smooth-minimal.py); the rim reuses the bot-screen bezel profile with a lower crown.
